# SPD-035 — Bash hook: Spud's relative redirection after a directory the hook cannot follow goes unchecked

## Brief
bash_reason skips a relative redirection or tee target whose directory is unknown (cwd None) when the caller is Spud, so Law 1 and Law 5 do not hold for it; members are refused. SPD-030 narrowed the cases (a directory the shell may or may not be in is now checked for both) but kept this one as it was.

Evidence: Pinned in tests/test_hooks.py ShellModelTest.test_directories_the_hook_cannot_follow on branch worktree-spd-030-bash-hook-cd-wrappers: for Spud, 'popd; echo x > ledger/tickets/SPD-001.md', 'cd -; ...', 'source x.sh; ...', 'cd $DIR; ...' and a relative cd in a loop are silent; the same with an absolute target is refused (Law 1). Fix sketch: refuse Spud too (his own files are few, so the cost is small), or check the target against the payload cwd as well.

## Size, persona and model decision
Batch plan v2, wave 3 with SPD-049, SPD-045 and SPD-037, same engineer on opus. Wholly inside shell/bash_rule.py. Spud's call stands: refuse Spud too, his own files are few.
